issue.title: Block - User
issue.body:
As a user, I want to block other users so that I can prevent them from interacting with me or seeing my posts.

**Acceptance Criteria:**  
1. The user can block another user from their profile or the blocked user's profile.  
2. Once blocked, the user can no longer follow, comment on, or like the blocker’s posts.  
3. Blocked users cannot send direct messages or interact with the blocker in any way.  
4. The user can unblock someone at any time from their profile.  
5. Blocked users are removed from the user's followers and following list.

performed_via_github_app.description:
## What is [CodSpeed](https://codspeed.io)?
CodSpeed is a **continuous benchmarking** platform that allows you to **track** and **compare** the **performance** of your codebase during development.

It uses a smart **runtime engine** to measure the performance of your code in an **accurate** and **reproducible** way without creating a huge **runtime overhead**, unlike traditional benchmarks.

CodSpeed produces detailed **performance reports** helping you **improve** your codebase **performance**, directly **within your repository provider** (Pull Requests comments, Merge checks, ...).

## How it works

The core of the **performance measurement** is done directly within your **CI environment** through the **CodSpeed Action**. Allowing you to **stay the sole owner** of your data and to keep your **codebase private**.

Once the performance data is generated, **only the benchmark results** are sent to the CodSpeed servers to be **analyzed**.

Then, performance reports are **generated** and **published** directly **within your repository provider**.

## How long does it take to install?

If you're **already benchmarking** your codebase, you can plug your **existing benchmarks** to CodSpeed in **less than 5 minutes** since CodSpeed benchmark's API is **compatible** with the most **popular benchmarking frameworks**.

If **you haven't any benchmarks yet**, we provide an **intuitive** benchmarking API that allows you to **create your first benchmarks** in a **few minutes**.

pull_request.title: Persisted Data Hooks and Drawer/Modal Routing with hash
pull_request.body:
If this seems like too much for one PR, I can split it up into a PR for persisted data hooks followed by PR for drawer/modal routing with hash.

# usePersistedX hooks
Moving data persisted through localForage (indexDB) to hooks that can be referenced from any component/hook.

Replaces instantiating persisted variables in `index.tsx` and prop-drilling them down to each component.

Uses [BroadcastChannel](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Broadcast_Channel_API) to keep persisted data synced across `usePersistedValue` calls and across tabs.

Note that loading data from localForage/indexDB is asynchronous, so it won't be immediately available on component load.

# Drawer routing
Move drawer/modal stuff to `main-layout.tsx`, driven by hash route rather than by `setDrawer`.

This allows the open drawer to be included in the URL, so it loads with the drawer open from link or from browser refresh.

Parsing the hash route to a component is done manually from the `useLocation` hook.

# Also
* Fix monster filters in encounter builder, and unique key for monster card when a monster group is copied to homebrew

> > But can we build everything without using .NET now?
> 
> No yet. sorry.
> 
> We have binary build archived to tar.gz on releases so it might be possible to just download prebuilt binary from github. (if macports allows), or just leave missing from macports is OK to me.

MP generally does not want pure binary redistribution if building from source is possible. I'll wait for litedb problems to be sorted out.
